scope.line: Caller-prepared intptr endpoints with representable differences/doubled error and addressable exact output. Literal dependent Bresenham recurrence first.
scope.rectangle: Dynamic-rank integer start/lengths after literal NumPy prefix; defaultxy first2 shape axes swap. Exact-count C buffers, no vector-copy.
scope.ellipse: Prepared float64 shiftedcenter/radii/sin/cos/bbox/offsets from literal providers; finite positive radii, nearest FP, exact-double grid indices; preserve division-before-square and strict<1, noFMA. mask/count-prefix then source row-major emit; boolfalse discards private buffers.
scope.providers: All Python conversion/rounding/clipping/error/protocol/policy/profile/layout wrapping remains explicit. Zero/negative/nonfinite/unsupported scalar geometries use literal tail when not admitted. No arbitrary captured1M bound imposed.
scope.workers: Caller snapshots existing optional global workers; independent rectangle/ellipse loops partition, dependent line recurrence serial initially; no custompool/forcedparallelism.
